For the Scorpio Cup, we're expecting Pace Chasers to be the best style to run, mostly due to the existence of Runaway Silence Suzuka, who can block Front Runners. Among the Pace Chasers, Taiki Shuttle (with enough Medium sparks) is shaping up to be one of the strongest, thanks to her improved Shooting for Victory! skill. Meisho Doto is also looking like a good pick for Pace.

Christmas Oguri Cap, which is projected to be released during the period of the Scorpio CM, is also expected be a very strong pick due to her unique skill. Not only does it provide her acceleration and velocity at an optimal point in the race (when triggered at the same time as Triple 7s), but also gives her recovery, potentially shielding herself from stamina debuffers.

In the Japanese version of the Scorpio Cup, Front Runners were the best option since Angling and Scheming is very powerful on this track. Summer Maruzensky, in particular, was the best choice since she could only realistically be blocked by another Summer Maruzensky. However, with Silence Suzuka being able to learn Runaway now, this makes it difficult for them to guarantee the lead at the final corner. In lobbies without Silence Suzuka, expect Front Runners to still be tough competition.

Scorpio Cup is notable for having several Umamusume releases in December that can be good for the track. All of them are best run as Late Surgers, so winning can still be a bit of a gamble. Manhattan Cafe has a speed debuff tied to her unique skill, Kimono Gold City has another final corner acceleration unique skill, which is suitable for the track, and Mejiro Dober has similar strengths to Mejiro Ryan while being able to use All-Seeing Eyes.

Scorpio Cup is a Medium Race, so expect to see Debuffers appearing again. Unlike other Medium tracks, this track is shorter at 2,000m, meaning speed debuffs like Dominator could be more impactful. Mystifying Murmur will likely only cripple unprepared opponents, since it should be easier to hit the stamina requirement. Hybrid debuffers that only carry one gold debuff should also be viable here.

analysis: As a Sprint race, Stamina is of least concern. Instead, try to focus on capping Speed and Power to maximize their top speed and acceleration in the late-race. As of July 1, 2026, we suggest building aces using the reworked Unity Cup scenario. This has higher Speed and Power caps compared to Trackblazer and also produces stronger aces compared to URA Finale.

Although the Unity Cup is generally the better scenario now, it still doesn't help much if your aces are lacking key skills, as skill hints are less abundant there. Trackblazer can get a lot of random skill hints from rival races, so it's still a viable scenario if your deck or trainee doesn't have good mid-race velocity or late-race acceleration. You can also amass more skill points here, possibly letting them beat out higher stat Umas from Unity Cup.

analysis: As another 2000m Medium race, we're expecting Christmas Oguri Cap to be the dominant ace again, much like the Aries Cup (CM12). Just like that race, she has 2 good activators for Festive Miracle in Triple 7s and U=ma2, making it unlikely for her to fail to use her powerful unique. In addition, her unique also being a recovery makes her not have to worry about stamina debuffers, making her the most effective runner by far.

Copano Rickey is very much hyped as a meta Dirt ace, and she can certainly prove her worth here. Although Christmas Oguri Cap is more consistent, Copano Rickey should be able to score some wins against her, provided her unique skill triggers as close to the start of the late-race as possible. You can even run both of them together to solidify your chances of winning, as they're both very strong contenders. Just make sure to give her 6 green skills for the race to maximize her unique's effect.

Outside of these top two, Front Runners should be able to compete thanks to being able to use Angling and Scheming. Both versions of Smart Falcon are great picks as they're specifically built for Dirt tracks.

Late Surgers also have lots of acceleration skills to choose from thanks to the July adjustments done to Slick Surge and Take the Chance. Some of the best runners for this style are Inari One and Agnes Digital.
As a Medium race with Christmas Oguri Cap, double Dominators are expected yet again. This time, they can also run 564 Escapades to also carry a second rare debuff like Keen Eye.

The high stamina requirement of this race also means Stamina debuffers with Mystifying Murmur could see some use, but they likely won't be able to affect Christmas Oguri Cap. To counter them, we recommend taking one rare recovery.
